svg.text: WikiBento — the 36 widget types, and how they relate
Rows: what you must supply. Colours: the Add-widget panel's own families. Badges: what gates a card. Generated from public/manifest.json — 2026-10-03
36 types = 33 data-driven + 9 static · 13 publish an output another card can consume · 5 consume another card's output · 9 need a category from the Commons Impact Metrics allow list
you bring the words (or the switch) — no subject to look up
Nothing at all — a platform-wide ranking
aggregate statistics about wikis and articles, no subject of yours
an article, a template, any wiki page — you name it, the wiki is a setting
A category in the CIM allow list
Commons Impact Metrics — precomputed, and only for ~1,775 registered primary categories
a file, a list of files, or a category/article that yields them
A URL, a domain or an archive item
something that lives elsewhere: a site, a domain, an archive.org identifier
you write the query, or give a coordinate / QID / page title
a transformer, a reducer and a readout — useless until something publishes to them
A card publishes a value on the board; another card reads it.
BOARD PARAMETERS (a hub, not a chain)
one click re-aims every card that references it
• layout: {i, x, y, w, h} for each id
• references: source id, or {{widget:id}} in text
Speaker (text-to-spee… · Map · Filter Lines · Line Count · Value Display
a source field names the publisher; {{widget:id}} works in any text field
✧ publishes an output another card can consume
⚡ static — renders from config, no fetch
🔌 needs our relay (map image, hatnote ranking, archive CDX)
🏆 rows: a ranking, a list, a table
